title: Coco and the guitar.
lines: In a colourful village in Mexico lives a boy called Miguel.
He is twelve years old.
He lives with his big family.
His dad, his mum, his grandma, and his very old great-grandmother, Mama Coco.
Mama Coco is so old that she hardly talks anymore.
She sits in her chair all day and smiles.
Miguel's family makes shoes.
Everyone makes shoes.
But Miguel doesn't want to make shoes.
Miguel wants to make music!
He wants to play the guitar and sing.
But that's not allowed.
Because in his family music is forbidden.
Long ago Mama Coco's father went away to make music.
He never came back.
Since then Grandma doesn't want to hear anything about music.
No guitar, no songs, nothing.
But Miguel practises in secret.
In the attic he has an old guitar that he made himself.
He plays very softly, so nobody hears.
It's the Day of the Dead.
That's a big festival in Mexico.
People remember their family members who have died.
They put photos on a table, with flowers, candles and tasty food.
Orange flowers, everywhere.
Because they believe that family members who have died come to visit that night.
There's a music contest in the square.
Miguel wants to take part.
But his guitar is broken.
He goes to the grave of a famous singer.
A beautiful white guitar hangs there.
Miguel takes the guitar off the wall and plays one note.
Ping!
And then something magical happens.
Everything changes.
The people in the graveyard can't see him anymore.
But now he sees other people.
Skeletons!
Cheerful skeletons, in beautiful clothes.
They're the people who have died, visiting their families.
Miguel has accidentally ended up in the Land of the Dead!
He walks over a bridge of orange flower petals.
On the other side is a beautiful city, full of lights and colours.
Big, colourful animals with wings fly around.
There Miguel meets his family.
His great-great-uncle and great-great-aunt, whom he only knows from photos.
They're very surprised to see him.
Miguel, you have to go back home, they say.
Before the sun comes up!
Otherwise you'll have to stay here.
Miguel also meets a funny skeleton with a straw hat.
His name is Hector.
Hector plays the guitar too.
He helps Miguel.
Together they sing and play.
Miguel learns a lot from Hector.
And then Miguel discovers something special.
Hector is really Mama Coco's father!
The man who went away with his guitar.
He wanted to come back, but he couldn't anymore.
He always missed his daughter.
He wrote a song for her.
A song he always sang.
Hector is sad.
Mama Coco is very old, he says.
If she forgets me, I'll disappear completely.
Because in the Land of the Dead you exist for as long as someone remembers you.
Now Miguel must go back quickly.
The family gives him a flower petal and a blessing.
And whoosh!
Miguel is back in the graveyard.
It's almost morning.
He runs home, with the guitar.
He goes to Mama Coco.
She's sitting in her chair.
Her eyes are closed.
Mama Coco, says Miguel softly.
I know your papa.
He never forgot you.
He takes the guitar and plays Hector's song.
The song Hector wrote for his daughter.
And Mama Coco opens her eyes.
She smiles.
And she starts to sing along.
Very softly.
Her voice trembles.
Papa, she says.
Everyone in the family cries, deeply moved.
Even Grandma.
Mama Coco takes an old photo out of her drawer.
It's a photo of Hector.
She puts it on the table with the other photos.
Now Hector will never be forgotten.
And from that day on music isn't forbidden in Miguel's house anymore.
The whole family sings.
And Miguel plays the guitar every evening for Mama Coco.
The end.
